canonical_project: AMRF1 Building 3A Data Centre (Aston Martin F1 Silverstone)

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Planning application 2025/3287/MAF to West Northamptonshire Council: demolition of temporary modular workshop and erection of a 2-storey ~1,400 sqm data centre with bridge link at Aston Martin Technology Campus, Silverstone (submitted Oct 2025, consulted by Buckinghamshire Council as adjoining LPA). Construction Map lists project period 2025-07-07 to 2026-05-01 with SDC Builders as principal contractor.
